name: Black Plastic Glasses
description_en:
Black Plastic Glasses (BPG) tracks the sources cited in AI-generated answers and connects those observations to outreach work. Users define buyer questions, inspect returned URLs and competing brands, then investigate cited Reddit threads, articles or videos. It is an AI citation research platform with paid action credits, rather than a conventional search-position tracker.

The current pages combine monitoring subscriptions with human-reviewed Reddit submissions and contact discovery. A cited source is evidence of one captured answer, not proof that paying for a post will influence later recommendations. The public site has inconsistent plan labels and engine descriptions, so the detailed pricing matrix should be checked at purchase.
description_zh:
Black Plastic Glasses（BPG）追踪 AI 答案引用的来源，并把观察结果衔接到外联工作。用户设定买家问题，查看返回的 URL 与竞品，再研究被引用的 Reddit 帖子、文章或视频。它属于带付费操作积分的 AI 引用研究平台，不是传统搜索排名工具。

当前页面把监测订阅、人工作品审核后的 Reddit 发布和联系人查找组合起来。某来源被引用只证明一次采集答案的情况，不能证明付费发帖会影响后续推荐。官网的套餐命名及引擎说明存在不一致，购买时应核对详细矩阵。

core_features.name_zh: 按提示词保存引用记录
core_features.explanation_en: Records cited URLs, domains, engines and brand appearances for configured questions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按配置问题保存引用 URL、域名、引擎与品牌出现情况。

core_features.name_zh: 经审核的 Reddit 内容发布
core_features.explanation_en: The customer writes content; BPG reviews it before posting through its accounts. Credits apply.
core_features.explanation_zh: 客户撰写内容，BPG 审核后通过其账户发布，消耗积分。

core_features.explanation_en: Finds article authors and public creator contacts with plan allowances and outreach status tracking.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按套餐额度查找文章作者及创作者公开联系信息，并跟踪外联状态。

en: From a buyer question to a reviewable action
zh: 从买家问题到可审核行动
use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Create an account, configure one buyer question and check how its citation history appears before expanding the prompt set. Assign ownership for factual review and approved outreach. The reviewed offering is accessed as a hosted account; no installable server or source-code license was established. BPG is a candidate for a team that wants source-level follow-up after monitoring; a pure rank tracker or a CRM serves a different task. Publishing failure refunds, contact-data freshness and export behavior remain unverified.
steps.zh: 注册账户后先配置一个买家问题，检查引用历史的呈现方式，再扩展问题集。指定事实审核与外联批准负责人。所读产品通过托管账户使用，未确认可安装服务器或源代码许可。它适合希望在监测后继续跟进具体来源的团队；纯排名工具或 CRM 处理的是不同任务。发布失败退款、联系人新鲜度及导出行为尚未核实。

items.en: The FAQ identifies ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overview; the headline also mentions Copilot. This research does not assume Copilot is included in every plan. AI answers vary with prompt wording, market and time. Keep these fixed when comparing periods and inspect answer sources rather than interpreting a citation change as revenue attribution. Vendor claims about the effect of Reddit mentions were not independently tested.
items.zh: FAQ 指出 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overview，标题另提到 Copilot。本研究不因此假定所有套餐包含 Copilot。AI 答案会随提示词、市场与时间变化。比较不同阶段时应固定这些条件，并检查答案来源，不能把引用变化直接解释为收入归因。厂商关于 Reddit 提及效果的主张未做独立验证。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The visible table lists Free at $0, Starter at $49/month, Pro at $149 and Business at $299, with 1, 15, 50 and 150 monitored prompts respectively. Starter updates weekly; Pro and Business daily. Comment/post credit costs are $10/$20 on Free and Starter, $8/$15 on Pro and $6/$12 on Business. Credits do not expire. Free monitoring therefore does not mean free publishing. FAQ references to Lurker, Contributor and Moderator do not match the current table names; confirm entitlements before paying.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 可见表格列出 Free 为 0 美元、Starter 每月 49 美元、Pro 149 美元、Business 299 美元，分别监测 1、15、50、150 个提示词。Starter 每周更新，Pro 与 Business 每日更新。评论／帖子积分费用在 Free 和 Starter 为 10／20 美元，Pro 为 8／15 美元，Business 为 6／12 美元；积分不过期。因此免费监测不等于免费发布。FAQ 的 Lurker、Contributor、Moderator 名称与当前表格不同，付款前需确认权益。

sections.title_en: From a buyer question to a reviewable action
sections.title_zh: 从买家问题到可审核行动
sections.en: For a hypothetical outdoor brand, define a question such as which rain jacket suits a particular climate. Compare the sources returned for the brand and competitors, and read the original article or thread before deciding whether a factual contribution is relevant. A Reddit contribution is written by your team and reviewed by BPG before publication. Contact lookup is a different action: identify an author, retain the source and track outreach status. None of these steps establishes an endorsement or a future AI citation.
sections.zh: 以户外品牌为假设例子，可设定某种气候适合哪款雨衣的问题。比较品牌与竞品被引用的来源，在决定是否适合补充事实前先读原文或讨论。Reddit 内容由团队撰写，BPG 审核后发布。查找联系人则是另一类动作：识别作者、保留来源并跟踪外联状态。这些步骤都不等于取得背书或保证未来被 AI 引用。
